metadata.title: Riedel-Kruse, Müller, Oates & Jülicher (2007) Science / Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. — Delayed Kuramoto Phase-Oscillator Lattice, Collective Frequency Shift & DAPT Initiation/Failure/Rescue Synchrony Dynamics in the Zebrafish Segmentation Clock

Morelli LG, Ares S, Herrgen L, Schröter C, Jülicher F, Oates AC (2009). Delayed coupling theory of vertebrate segmentation. HFSP Journal 3(1):55-66.

zebrafish_psm_synchrony_specimen.species: Gallus gallus (chick) embryo per the Wikimedia source title 'Aves Neural tube and somites in chick embryo' — dorsal scanning electron micrograph showing central neural tube, presomitic mesoderm, and bilateral segmented somite metameres; used as a vertebrate somite-metamere stand-in, NOT a Danio rerio specimen (species label corrected in Pass 3, 2026-10-19; file name retained because it is SHA-256-pinned)

riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.section: Riedel-Kruse et al. (2007) Science 317:1911-1915 Eq. 1 & SOM; Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. 3:55-66 Eqs. 1-5
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.delayed_kuramoto_lattice_sde: dtheta_i(t)/dt = omega_0 + (kappa / z) * sum_{j in N(i)} sin(theta_j(t - tau_c) - theta_i(t)) + xi_i(t)
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.collective_frequency_shift_law: Omega = omega_0 - kappa * sin(Omega * tau_c),  T_sync = 2 * pi / Omega
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.linear_stability_criterion: kappa_eff = kappa * cos(Omega * tau_c) > 0  (stable in-phase synchrony for cos(Omega * tau_c) > 0; anti-phase instability for cos(Omega * tau_c) < 0)
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.ald_anterior_limit_of_defects_law: ALD(s_in) = s_in + Delta_n_ALD,  where Delta_n_ALD = ln(R_SS / R_crit) / (D_phi * T_0) + Delta_n_det ~ 5.5 somites
riedel_kruse_2007_morelli_2009_governing.prp_posterior_rescue_point_law: PRP(s_out) = s_out + Delta_n_PRP,  where Delta_n_PRP ~ 5.5 somites after DAPT washout at stage s_out

canonical_zebrafish_psm_parameters.species: Danio rerio (zebrafish presomitic mesoderm at 28 C)
canonical_zebrafish_psm_parameters.canonical_parameter_note: Pass 3 (2026-10-19) corrected Omega / T_sync / kappa_eff to the self-consistent root of Omega = omega_0 - kappa*sin(Omega*tau_c) (omega_0 = 0.251327, kappa = 0.070, tau_c = 20.5): the Pass 1-2 entries 0.2896 / 21.70 / 0.0566 were not roots of that equation; the script's --self-test now asserts parity with these values.

pass3_kinematic_wave_and_mib1_mechanisms.section: Pass 3 (2026-10-19) reduced mechanisms added to 2006-riedel-delta-notch-phase-synchrony.py; all rate constants below are this script's declared choices unless a source is named

fgf8_wnt_frequency_profile.law: omega(xi) = omega_0 * exp(-xi / lambda_F), xi = distance from tailbud in somite lengths S; lambda_F = L / ln(1 / f_A) so omega(front) = f_A * omega_0
fgf8_wnt_frequency_profile.source: Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. 3:55-66 frequency profile; Dubrulle et al. (2001) Cell 106:219-232 tailbud-anchored FGF8 gradient; Soroldoni et al. (2014) Science 345:222-225 kinematic waves
fgf8_wnt_frequency_profile.delay_scaling: tau_c(x) = tau_c * omega_0 / omega(x) (coupling delay scales with the local autonomous period; declared assumption)
fgf8_wnt_frequency_profile.kinematic_wave_law: k(x) = (Omega / v) * (1 - omega(x)/omega_0), v = S / T_seg; N_w = (1/S) * Int_0^L (1 - omega/omega_0) dx; anterior wavelength / S = 1 / (1 - f_A)
fgf8_wnt_frequency_profile.empirical_anchor: Soroldoni et al. (2014) and Morelli et al. (2009) report of order 1-2 her1/deltaC expression waves across the zebrafish PSM, with waves slowing toward the anterior; not digitised

mib1_deltac_ubiquitination_gate.law: du/dt = k_ub * M * (1 - u) - k_endo * u; u_ss = k_ub M / (k_ub M + k_endo); kappa(t) = kappa_max * u(t) * g(t)
mib1_deltac_ubiquitination_gate.source: Itoh et al. (2003) Dev Cell 4:67-82 (Mind bomb E3 ubiquitin ligase required for Delta endocytosis and trans-activation of Notch)

dapt_gamma_secretase_gate.law: g(t) = 1 / (1 + (C(t)/IC50)^n); C/IC50 = dose_ratio during treatment, then C(t) = C(t_out) * exp(-(t - t_out)/tau_wash)
dapt_gamma_secretase_gate.source: Riedel-Kruse et al. (2007) Science 317:1911-1915 DAPT pulse-washout protocol

emergent_ald_prp_readout.law: ALD = s_cross + Delta_n_det, PRP = s_recross + Delta_n_det, where s_cross / s_recross are the first somite stages at which the half-period-smoothed lateral Kuramoto R of the anterior somite-length block falls below / recovers above R_crit = 0.50; PRP - ALD = s_recross - s_cross
emergent_ald_prp_readout.somite_stage_clock: ds/dt = Omega(kappa(t)) / 2 pi (collective frequency at the instantaneous coupling; DAPT lengthens the period to T_0, Herrgen et al. 2010)
emergent_ald_prp_readout.calibrated_parameters: D_phi = 0.003 rad^2/min and sigma_omega = 0.014 rad/min were calibrated so that the emergent desynchronisation lag matches the observed ALD(s_in) data (Riedel-Kruse 2007 fitted its desynchronisation rate the same way); tau_wash = 8 min was chosen so the emergent PRP lies within the observed PRP +/- SD

riedel_kruse_2007_dapt_perturbation_regi.source: Riedel-Kruse, Müller & Oates (2007) Science 317:1911-1915 Figs. 1-4; Morelli et al. (2009) HFSP J. 3:55-66; Herrgen et al. (2010) Current Biology 20:1244-1253

regimes.label: Wild-type DMSO control (continuous DeltaC-Notch coupling kappa = 0.070 min^-1, tau_c = 20.5 min)
Continuous DAPT Notch blockade at gastrulation (s_in = 0 somite stage; mimics bea/des/aei/mib)
Continuous DAPT Notch blockade added at 4-somite stage (s_in = 4)
Continuous DAPT Notch blockade added at 9-somite stage (s_in = 9)
DAPT pulse-chase rescue (DAPT in at s_in = 0, washed out at s_out = 9 -> ALD = 5.5, PRP = 14.5)
